device.description: 16-bit 100 kHz 2.7-5.5 V micropower unipolar sampling ADC with 3-wire serial interface
device.note: ads8325.pdf (SBAS226C) p.2 recommended operating conditions, p.3-6 electrical characteristics (straight binary), p.7 pin configurations and assignments, p.8-9 timing information (Table 1), p.19 digital interface, serial interface, data format

pages: p.2 (recommended operating conditions: VDD 2.7-3.6 V or 4.5-5.5 V), p.3 tCONV 6.667-666.7 us, p.7 (pins, DGK and DRB same numbering), p.8-9 (timing diagram, Table 1: tDIS 100 ns max), p.19 (signal levels, serial interface, data format: straight binary)
notModeled: analog input (unipolar +IN - -IN, 0 to VREF; 0 V reads 0000h); the conversion is clocked by DCLOCK (16 clocks, not timed: the result is the 0 V code at once)

DOUT is Hi-Z for the 4.5-5.0 clock sample period, then the null bit and B15..B0; after B0 the result repeats LSB first (zeros for the 0 V code) and DOUT tri-states after B15 has been repeated (text); the timing-diagram note says zeros follow indefinitely
tOut: Table 1 gives no DCLOCK-falling-to-next-DOUT-valid maximum (only tHDO 5 ns min, tEN 50 ns max), so tOut is 0
auto power-down after the conversion and shutdown while CS/SHDN is high (no visible bus effect)
throughput (100 kHz) and DCLOCK frequency limits (0.024-2.4 MHz)
DRB thermal pad (substrate; not a pin)
